output_list.criticism: The initialSupply is not checked for overflow. If the initialSupply is too large, it will cause an integer overflow and the totalSupply will be incorrect.

The balanceOf[_from] -= _value; and balanceOf[_to] += _value; lines are vulnerable to integer overflow. If the _value is too large, it will cause an integer overflow and the balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] will be incorrect.

The _transfer(msg.sender, _to, _value); line is vulnerable to integer overflow. If the _value is too large, it will cause an integer overflow and the balanceOf[msg.sender] and balanceOf[_to] will be incorrect.
The _transfer(_from, _to, _value); line is vulnerable to integer overflow. If the _value is too large, it will cause an integer overflow and the balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] will be incorrect.

The allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value; line is vulnerable to integer overflow. If the _value is too large, it will cause an integer overflow and the allowance[msg.sender][_spender] will be incorrect.
